run_bloat_diff: run the bloat diff script to compare binary size between two git commits
run_bloat_diff_with_base: run the bloat diff script with a diff base commit to compare libgrpc binary bloat
build_grpc_libs: build the grpc shared libraries and rename the output directory for bloat analysis
run_bloaty_analysis: run bloaty on libgrpc.so and libgrpc++.so to analyze compile units and symbols
check_on_pr_bloat: post the bloat difference results to the pull request using check_on_pr
